value: Schedule applicable inspections before concealing work; provide site access and a responsible person.
Ground-mounted installations: footing and underground raceway/conduit inspections where that work is included, followed by final inspection.
Roof-mounted installations: rough inspection for concealed wiring and applicable array bonding/grounding checks, followed by final inspection.
Structural foundation, rough and final inspections apply when required by the permitted structural scope.
Keep approved plans, the inspection record card and manufacturer instructions on site, with the conditional utility-disconnect or service-upgrade documents.
After final inspection approval for all related City permits, the City notifies SDG&E. City approval alone does not authorize energization; separate SDG&E approval is required.

Underground and structural inspections are conditional, not universal rooftop steps. Current SDG&E application requirements, charges and permission-to-operate timing remain Not yet verified; no cross-utility comparison is asserted.

timeline_days.notes: IB-301 does not specify a standard turnaround/timeline for residential review. It mentions an 'Express Plan Check' service (1.5x regular fees) for faster review, but explicitly states this expedited option is 'not available for single-family/duplex/ADU projects' — the exact category most residential solar falls into — so it does not provide a usable residential timeline either.

value.program_or_pathway: Self-issued residential solar PV permit, no plan review (Information Bulletin 301)
other_conditions: Self-issued eligibility is for qualifying rooftop single-family, duplex or townhouse installations designed using the residential PV plan template; these are pathway limits, not universal citywide limits.
Energy storage systems up to 38.4 kWh total, with individual units not exceeding 20 kWh
Panel upgrades permitted up to 320 amps under the same self-issued pathway
An EV charger integrated into the inverter may be included.

Neither fire plan review nor structural review may be required for the self-issued route; consult IB-301 Structural Review, Plans and Calculations and Fire Roof Access and Pathways for review triggers.
No additional work requiring a Combination Building Permit, such as structural modifications or a new structure, is eligible under the self-issued route.
Ground-mounted PV with supports higher than five feet requires a Building Permit or Combination Building Permit; it is outside this rooftop self-issued route.
Self-issued permitting is distinct from optional Express Plan Check; IB-301 excludes single-family, duplex and ADU projects from Express Plan Check.

permit_fees.notes: Fee scope checked on 2026-10-12: IB-301 (May 2026) lists Electrical Permit components and includes service-panel upgrades up to 320 amps. Do not sum alternative residential and non-residential schedules or present these components as a complete project quote. ESS plan review/inspection is hourly; structural, zoning, brush/landscape and historical reviews may add hourly charges. Building/Combination Building Permits incur separate applicable fees under IB-501 (August 2026). IB-501 exempts no-plan-review projects from its General Plan Maintenance Fee; do not add general construction fees automatically. IB-103 (May 2026) routes PV fees to IB-301, so do not automatically add a standalone panel-upgrade fee. Online bank/processing charges may apply. SDG&E fees remain Not yet verified and are excluded.
